responsibility: This file implements the GCC-backed `Linemap` and `RichLocation` services used by the Rust frontend for source position tracking and fix-it capable diagnostics. It creates and manages file and line map state in GCC's global line tables, converts columns to `Location` objects, stringifies locations, exposes file/line/column queries, and wraps GCC `rich_location` operations for ranges and insertions, serving as the concrete source-location backend for lexing, parsing, and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Provides the GCC-specific implementation of the abstract linemap API from `rust-linemap.h` by defining `Gcc_linemap`, constructing `Location` values from GCC line tables, and implementing `RichLocation` fix-it/range operations on top of GCC `rich_location`. Unlike the header, this `.cc` file is the concrete backend binding to GCC linemap machinery.
